༄༅/ /phyag chen lnga ldan gyi khrid yig kun mkhyen chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa bzhugs/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// phyag chen lnga ldan gyi khrid yig kun mkhyen chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa bzhugs// (444)༄༅// na maḥshrī gu ra we// srid dang zhi ba'i rol pa bgrangs yas kyis// mi 'gyur gdod nas grub pa rdo rje sems// gnyug ma'i rang bab ma bcos bla ma la// btud nas phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag bri// de yang sngon 'gro byang sems sbyong ba dang*// yi dam lha dang bla ma bsgom pa dang*// dngos gzhi phyag rgya chen por mnyam bzhag cing*// rjes la bsngo bas rgyas gdab bcas pa ni// thun khong rer yang tshang bar nyams blang phyir// phyag chen lnga ldan zhes byar yongs su grags// de la dang po byang sems sbyong ba ni// kun rdzob sems bskyed nyid yin de la yang*// 'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro bzhin pa 'dra ba'i// smon 'jug gnyis so smon pa sems bskyed ni// 'gro ba mtha' dag pha mar ma gyur med// bde ba 'dod kyang bde ba'i thabs ma shes// sdig pa 'ba' zhig spyad pas 'khor bar 'khyams// de la kun khyab byams dang snying rje ni// rtag tu bsgom zhing de don rang nyid kyis// byang chub bsgrub snyam snying nas smon pa'o// 'jug pa sems bskyed sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i rgyu// phar phyin drug gam bcu yin (445)de dag kyang*// tshogs gnyis la 'dus de phyir tshul khrims ni// bsod nams tshogs yin lhag mthong ye shes tshogs// gnyis kar gtogs pa zhi gnas bsam gtan ste// de rnams le lo med par bsgrub snyam pa'i// dam bca' dang bcas rtse gcig sgrub pa yin// gnyis pa rang lus yi dam lhar bsgom ste// lhag lha dmigs gsal yod dam med kyang rung*// 'jig rten dbang phyug phyag bzhi pa bsgom zhing*// snang grags rigs gsum lha sngags ting 'dzin gyis// lam du khyer zhing tha mal zhen pa spong*// gsum pa rang lhar gsal ba'i spyi gtsug tu// pad zla'i steng bzhugs rtsa ba'i bla ma ni// dkon mchog kun 'dus rdo rje 'chang chen ni// bka' brgyud bla mas bskor bar gsal btab nas// dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje nus pas kyang*// bla ma med par gdul bya'i rgyud mi smin// khyad par rgyal ba rnams kyi mthu rdugs pa'i// snyigs ma'i skye bo rmu rgod gyur pa la'ang*// dge ba'i sems gcig skyes pa nas brtsams te// thabs mkhas tshul gyis phan gdags grangs las 'das// des (446)na sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam pa'am// lhag par bsams nas rtse gcig gsol ba 'debs// mthar ni tshar gsum khug pa'i dbang blangs nas// bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim pa'i mdo// rdo rje gsum dang rang gi sgo gsum po// dbyer med gyur snyam ma bcos rang bab bzhag

/bzhi pa dngos gzhi phyag chen bsgom pa la// go bya dang ni nyams su len pa gnyis// dang po snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams kyi// rang bzhin gdod nas rnam dag chos dbyings de// zab gsal gnyis med mtha' bral 'dus ma byas// de la dang po'i sangs rgyas zhes bya dang*// rgyu rgyud dang ni gnas lugs phyag chen dang*// bder gshegs snying po zhes kyang rab tu grags// rang bzhin rnam dag mkha' 'dra de nyid la// glo bur rnam rtog g.yos pas bdag dang ni// bdag gir bzung ste ma rig pa la sogs// rten 'brel lugs 'byung 'khor ba'i 'khor lor grub// 'di yi rang mtshan bla mas ngo sprad nas// 'khor ba'i rtsa ba bdag 'dzin yin pa dang*// de yi rtsa ba rnam rtog yin shes na// me bsad du ba ngang gis 'gag 'gyur bzhin// rnam rtog spangs pa'i stong nyid bsgoms pa ni// thar lam mchog ste de nyid rtogs pa'i thabs// sngags su bskyed rim rlung sbyor 'bar 'dzag sogs// du mar gsungs dang mdo las zhi gnas kyi// dmigs pa sna tshogs lhag mthong gtan 'bebs sogs// bgrang yas gsungs pa de dag thams cad yin// ci phyir zhe na stong nyid ma rtogs par// 'khor ba las brgal sangs rgyas 'byung mi srid// de phyir rgyal bas chos rnams gang bstan pa// stong pa nyid la gzhol zhing 'bab ces gsungs// 'phags pas stong nyid bsgoms pas grol 'gyur gyi// sgom pa lhag pa de don yin ces gsungs// de ltar rnam rtog spong zhing sgom pa la'ang*// mu stegs 'ga' zhig rtog med mchog gi bdag /(447)yin snyam 'du shes log pa'i bsgom pa dang*// rtog med ting 'dzin hwa shang lugs yin zhes/ las dang po yi zhi gnas bkag pa dang*// phyis dus grags ldan chen po phal cher gyis// rnam rtog phreng ba sgom du smra ba sogs// dri ma can gyi bsam gtan rab spangs nas// rgyal ba'i bka' la brgyud pa'i man ngag gis// brgyan pa kha tsam ma yin myong khrid kyis// 'khrid byas skal ldan dag gis nyams myong ba'i// ting 'dzin shes rab zung du 'jug pa ni// lam du bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po dang*// thabs kyi rgyud dang lam gyi bden pa dang*// ye shes tshogs zhes bya bar bzhed pa yin// de yang ting 'dzin zhes pa rtog med du// rtse gcig gnas pa'i zhi gnas bsam gtan yin// rtog bral ma 'khrul 'od gsal sems nyid de// chos rnams kun gyi gnas tshul yin pa'i phyir// 'khor 'das mtha' dag skye med spros bral du// rtogs pa'i nges shes gting nas shar ba ni// lhag mthong dang ni shes rab ces su bshad// zhi lhag de gnyis mnyam par bzhag dus su// ngo bo gcig pas zung 'jug ces bya zhing*// mnyam rjes 'dres par ma gyur de srid du// rjes thob dpyod pa'i shes rab gtso bo yin// mdo las lhag mthong la ni rig pa dang*// zhi gnas la ni rkang pa'i sgra bstan te// mig gis rig pa med na rkang pa yis// 'gro ba'i lam mi shes zhing mi rig kyang*// rkang pa med na der bgrod ga la nus// de phyir rig dang rkang par ldan ces gsungs// de ltar bsgoms pas chos dbyings mkha' 'dra la// rang bzhin gnas pa'i dri ma mi srid kyang*// glo bur nyon shes dri ma sprin 'dra ba// rim gyis sangs pas sa bcu lam lnga dang*// shān+ti pas bzhed rtse gcig spros bral dang*// ro gcig sgom med sogs kyi dbye ba rnams// rnam par bzhag cing dri ma bag (448)chag bcas// gtan zad tshe na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes// mkha' khyab chos sku mngon du gyur ba na// bsod nams tshogs kyi gzugs sku 'bras bu gnyis// nyid dang 'od ltar 'bad med 'byung ba ni// 'bras bu'i rgyud dang 'bras bu'i sangs rgyas dang*// bde gshegs snying po dag pa gnyis ldan zhes// rgyal ba'i bstan 'dir rab tu grags pa yin// gnyis pa nyams len dngos la bzhag thabs gnyis// lus kyi bzhag thabs rnam snang chos bdun bcas// sems kyi bzhag thabs 'das dang ma 'ong gi// rnam rtog chogs la sngon bsu rjes 'brang min// da lta'i shes pa cer gyis ngos bzung nas// bzo bcos med par de steng lhod kyis bzhag

/rtogs pa 'phro na 'phro mkhan ngos bzung ste// dgag sgrub spang blang mi bya de ngang klod// gal te rtse gcig pa nyid ma thob na// shing bu rde'u lha sku yig 'bru sogs// sems 'dzin dmigs rten gang mos zhig la gtad// rim gyis goms nas cung zad sems brtan tshe// thun thung grangs mang bya zhing thun gyi skabs// dang por tshogs drug shes pa thams cad kun// dran pa rtse gcig steng du hril gyis dril// de ma thag tu sog bon mdud chad ltar// lhod kyis klod nas ma yengs tsam ma gtogs// bsgom bya sgom byed yod med yin min dang*// bde gsal mi rtog stong pa la sogs pa// 'di bsgom snyam pa'i gtad so thams cad spang*// tha mar gzing la 'phur ba'i bya rog bzhin// dran pa rang so ma shor tsam nyid las// rig pa bdag bzung med par ci dgar bsgyur// de la brten nas tshogs drug yul snang dang*// na tsha nyon mongs rnam par rtog pa la// dmigs rten byas nas bsres te bsgom pa yin// de dag rnams kyis mi g.yel ting 'dzin 'phel// mdor na zhi gnas bsam gtan sgom pa'i tshe// ha cang klod na bying (449)bar 'gyur ba ste// grims drags rgod cing shes pa sor mi gnas// grims la skyon yon sems gdungs gyur ba ste// the tshom dbang gyur rtse gcig mi 'thob pas// spro dang nges shes grim lhod ran pas bsgom// bde gsal stong pa'i nyams snang ci shar yang*// chags na 'khor bar gol bas zhen med du// dgag sgrub med par rang ngo shes bzhin bskyang*// de nas lhag mthong ngo sprod gdab pa ni// byams pa mgon pos mdo sde rgyan nyid du// sems las gzhan med par ni blos rig nas// de nas sems kyang stong pa nyid du rtogs// blo dang ldan pas gnyis po med rig nas// de mi ldan pa chos kyi dbyings gnas shes// gsungs pa bzhin du lung dang rig pa dang*// nyams myong tshad ma gsum gyis gtan phebs nas// dang po rtog pa'i yo lang snang ba kun// sems tsam nyid las gzhan du ma grub pa// dper na rmi lam yul bzhin shes par bya// thogs med sems las sra gsher drod la sogs// thogs bcas dngos po grub pa ci snyam na// ba lang rdzi yis spyi bor rwa bsgom pas// mngon sum skyes dang sngags pas klu bsgrubs pas// sog ma med par gyur pa'i gtam rgyud dang*// bskyed rim brtan pas yi dam lha mthong sogs// tshe gcig nyid la'ang de bzhin 'grub 'gyur na// thog med dus nas bag chags ngan goms pas// de ltar 'grub par mi 'gyur ci zhig yod// chu phor gang la lha yis bdud rtsi dang*// yi dwags rnams kyis rnag khrag mthong ba dang*// ril gzhi bdag rnams kyis khang bzang dang*// mi yis sa rdo phal par mthong ba sogs// sems snang tsam las bden par med pa'i rtags// de ltar yul snang sems su nges byas nas// sems kyang stong pa nyid du shes bya ste// sems la dngos por grub (450)pa rdul tsam med// ci phyir zhe na yul gyi rkyen snang tshe// rig tsam tur tsam skad cig skye zhing 'gags// de yang rnam shes tshogs brgyad dbye ba can// re re'i gzhi rtsa bcad na rtsa ba gtor// kun gzhi zhes pa ming tsam las gzhan med// dper na smig sgyu la ni chu med kyang*// ri dwags skom pas chur 'khrul rjes snyegs bzhin// shin tu brdzun pa'i sems 'dir bdag bzung nas// las ngan gsog pa ches cher 'khrul pa yin// des na rgyal bas mdo sde'i sde snod du// sems la sems ma mchis zhes gsal bar gsungs// sems med gyur na de yi rang bzhin ni// 'od gsal yin zhes gsungs pa ci zhe na// sems zhes bya ba rnam shes tshogs brgyad de// de dag 'khrul pa'i rang bzhin rnam rtog yin// sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ces bya ba// rtog med ma 'khrul rang rig ye shes yin// de ni gsar du bsgoms pas thob pa'am// rgyal ba'i thugs rjes stsal ba ma yin te// thog med rgyu rgyud rang bzhin gnas rigs de// rang gi tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong bsgoms stobs dang*// rtog ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs ngo sprod kyis// rang la yod pa rang gis mthong ba yin// de phyir gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni rnyed pa ma yin te// dpal ldan bla ma'i dus thabs bsten pa dang*// bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya zhes gsungs// de ltar gzung ba'i yul dang 'dzin pa'i sems// gnyis dang bral ba'i rang bzhin lhan cig skyes// mkha' ltar dag cing rgya chad phyogs lhung med// spros bral zhi lhag zung du 'jug pa der// skad cig tsam yang mnyam par bzhag nus na// bskal par bsags pa'i mun pa 'joms zhes gsungs// de lta'i spros bral phyag rgya chen po de// mdo sngags gnyis ka'i lta ba'i snying po'o// slob dpon (451)klu sogs dbu ma las lhag pa'i// lta ba med ces gsungs dang tshul sgron las// don gcig ces bshad lta ba gcig pa'i don// des na bla med dbang bzhi brgya phrag tu// rang gis nod cing gzhan la bskur bzhin du// bzhi ba'i dbang don phyag rgya chen po ni// rang gis nyams su len pa lta ci smos// ming tsam thos na rna ba 'gebs pa ni// 'dod khams bdag po'i las las gzhan ci zhig

/de ltar zung 'jug rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i tshe// bde gsal mi rtog rnams la zhen gyur na// 'dod gzugs gzugs med rnams su gol 'gyur bas// ma zhen mi 'gogs shugs 'byung bskyang bar bya// gzhan yang go ba tsam gyis chog rloms dang*// snang ba bshigs nas stong bar dmigs pa dang*// cung zad tsam zhig rnam rtog 'gags pa la// g.yang sa lta bur 'jigs par lta ba dang*// rnam rtog gang shar skyon du 'dzin pa sogs// blos byas rtog ge'i grub mtha'i kun spangs nas// gang shar bzo med rang babs skyong ba dang*// ma yengs mi bsgom lhug par 'jog pa sogs// grub pa'i gdams ngag nyams myong brgyan pa yi// lugs bzhin brtson 'grus brtsams nas sgom pa'i tshe// ye shes snying nas shar zhing sgro 'dogs chod// mi 'dod bzhin du lam rtags yon tan 'phel// dngul chu sa la bo ba ji bzhin du// chos brgyad rdul dang ma 'dres 'khor ba yi// bde 'byor kun la dug bzhin zhen pa log /stong dang rten 'byung zung 'jug gnad go bas// thabs shes zung 'brel don gnyis lhun grub tu// byung na dge sbyor gnad du song zhes bya// de ltar sngon 'gro gsum po bsod nams tshogs// dngos gzhi ye shes tshogs te tshogs gnyis kyi// 'bras bu sku gnyis sam ni sku gsum 'thob// de yang gzhi dang lam gyi 'od (452)gsal gnyis// ma bu 'phrad ces 'dres par gyur pa'i tshe// rdzogs sangs rgyas zhes bya zhing de yi tshe// ngo bo stong pa chos kyi sku yin cing*// rang bzhin gsal ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// rtsal snang 'gag med sprul sku rab 'byams ste// thams cad rdzogs pa bde ba chen po'i sku// sku bzhi'i rang bzhin gdod ma'i gnas lugs te// rang ngo shes pa 'bras bu'i mchog yin phyir// re dogs med pa 'bras bu yin ces gsungs/ ༈ /lnga pa rjes la bsngo ba'i rgyas 'debs ni// rang rig bder gshegs snying po'i dkyil 'khor du// tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i dge ba des mtshon te// dus gsum dge ba ji snyed yod do 'tshal// gcig bsdus las dang byed po bsngo yul bcas// 'khor gsum mi dmigs stong nyid lta ba yis// zin pa'i ngang nas bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun// 'khor ba'i gzeb las myur du thar gyur te// zung 'jug lhan skyes ye shes phyag rgya che'i// go 'phang thob phyir rtse gcig bsngo bar bya// de yang dge ba rgya chen ci bsgrubs kyang*// 'khor gsum yongs dag lta bas ma zin na// rgyal bas sher phyin la sogs mdo sde ru// mig dang bral ba'i skye bo lta bu dang*// dug 'dres kha zas za ba 'drar gsungs pas// skyon med thar ba'i rgyu ru mi 'gyur phyir// des na bag dang ldan pas rnam kun tu// bskyed rdzogs rnal 'byor dge sbyor ci byed kyang*// 'bad pas byang chub sa bon thebs par mdzod// de ltar thun khong gcig tu yan lag lnga// tshang bar nyams su len cing las dang pos// dngos gzhi zhig nas sems 'dzin la sogs pa// skabs su gang babs bsgom zhing goms pa'i tshe// zung 'jug rnal 'byor las gzhan spros mi dgos// de nas zhor byung dus dang sbyar ba ni// tho rangs ye shes gsal (453)'debs rnal 'byor zhes// gnyid las langs ma thag tu rnam rtog gis// bar ma chad par gsal stong zung 'jug gi

/rig pa ngos bzung gshis la mnyam par bzhag /de ma rtogs pa'i 'gro ba thams cad la// snying rje drag po bsgoms nas dge sbyor brtsam// des ni nyams len brod cing mgo nas legs// dge sbyor srol du 'jug pa'i man ngag yin// nyin mo snang ba rgyas 'debs rnal 'byor ni// snang ba mtha' dag 'khrul pa'i sems yin zhing*// 'khrul pa'i rang bzhin med pa rmi lam 'dra// rmi lam dngos bzung mi btub stong pa nyid// de ltar lta zhing rgyas btab sgom pas ni// 'khrul dbang mi 'chor rig pa'i rtsal 'byongs shing*// bar do'i gnas skabs sbyong ba'i man ngag yin// nang nub 'dod yon grogs khyer rnal 'byor ni// bza' btung gos dang gnas mal la sogs pa// rab tu zhen med stong par shes pa'i ngang*// chos nyid rang la rang thim tshul du sbyang*// de tsam ma nus lha dang bla ma ni// mchod pa'i tshul du longs su spyad bya ste// 'dod yon mi 'ching tshogs rdzogs man ngag yin// srod la dbang po gzhi bsdu'i rnal 'byor ni// nyin mor 'khrul pa'i dran pa ci shar yang*// 'phro mi mthud par rang ngo cer cer blta// mtshan mo'i dge sbyor srol 'dzud man ngag yin// nam gung shes pa bum gzhug rnal 'byor ni// snying dkyil la ma bsgoms nas gsol ba btab// rnam rtog rbad bcad chos nyid spros bral la// mnyam par bzhag bzhin gnyid du 'gro bar bya// des ni 'di dang 'chi ba'i gnas skabs su// 'od gsal ma bu bsre ba'i gdams ngag yin// 'chi kha ye shes zang thal rnal 'byor mi// dngos po kun la chags zhen rbad kyis bcad// 'di dang tshe rabs nyes ltung thams cad (454)bshags// rang gzhan dge ba thams cad gsal btab nas// yi rang bsgom zhing byang chub chen por bsngo// khyad par lcogs na phung po'i mchod sbyin bya// rang sems skye 'chi med par thag bcad nas// thim rim la sogs gang dgar bor bya zhing*// dmigs pa'i tsab tsub mang po mi byed par// sgom dang mi sgom rdul tsam med pa yi// rang bab phyag rgya che la mnyam bzhag bzhin// zang thal chos sku'i klong du 'pho bar bya// des ni ngan song ngan 'gro'i sgo 'geg cing*// 'khor ba spyi dang khyad par bar do yi// 'khrul pa'i nyer len gcod par byed pa dang*// 'chi ba chos skur rtogs pa'i man ngag yin// de ltar phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi// gdams pa nyung ngu las kyang ches nyung 'di// sde dge sa dbang chen po'i mdun na 'don// bsgres po chos song blo gros zhal snga nas// bskul bar mdzad pas gang dran ldeb sbyor gyis// ma bcings bab col lhug par smra ba po// gtsug lag chos kyi snang ba zhes bya'o/// /
